body:
WHAT
When the model Writes a brand-new source file, the reuse check compares the new file's exported symbol names and file stem against a symbol index of the workspace, with no model call. If similar code exists and the model made no related Grep/Glob/GraphQuery search and read none of the matches this session, a reminder listing the closest matches (firm wording at or above blockThreshold, softer above remindThreshold) is attached to the next message. The Write itself always goes through.

WHY
Agents often write a second copy of something that exists; refusing the Write used to make the agent 'suddenly stop', so the check now reminds instead of blocking.

WHERE
engine/core/src/knowledge/reuseGate.ts — SearchLog (record/overlaps, CAP 500), evaluateReuseGate() (12-step decision table), isTestPath(), firmRemindMessage(), remindMessage(), ReuseGateResult. Wired in engine/core/src/runtime/session.ts — Session.evaluateWriteReuseGate(), searchLog.record(tool.searchTerms(input)), `if (gate.kind === 'remind') this.remind(gate.text)`, Session.loadSymbolIndex(). Similarity from engine/core/src/knowledge/symbols.ts — findSimilarSymbols(), tokensOf().

TEST CHECKLIST
1. evaluateReuseGate for a new src/userFormatter.ts exporting formatUser, against an index holding src/format/user.ts with symbol formatUser, an empty SearchLog and wasRead=false, returns kind 'remind' whose text starts with 'Reuse check:' and lists 'src/format/user.ts — formatUser' with a score; it never returns a refusal kind.
2. The same call after searchLog.record(['formatUser']) returns {kind:'pass'}; likewise when wasRead(join(cwd,'src/format/user.ts')) is true.
3. cfg.mode 'off', a target under tests/ or named x.test.ts, a .md/.json target, a path outside cwd, or an already-existing file all return pass without calling loadIndex.
4. A best score >= blockThreshold yields the firm text ('very similar code already exists'), a score between remindThreshold and blockThreshold yields the softer 'similar code may already exist', and loadIndex throwing yields pass.
5. End-to-end with a FakeProvider scripting a Write of a near-duplicate file then end_turn: the Write tool result is success, and the following user message contains a system-reminder with 'Reuse check:'.
